decision.summary: A multi-axis coherent shift occurs between indices 487–489, with sustained platform behavior through 520. No return to pre-event levels is observed within the allowed context [450,579]; thus the interval is classified as uncertain. The onset is abrupt and cross-axis consistent, but absence of recovery prevents confirmation of a temporary offset.

intervals.observation: N/E/U show a multi-axis coherent step onset around index 487–489: N rises from ~0.1 to ~1.8, E from ~2.4 to ~5.2, U from ~-0.4 to ~1.3; all three axes then sustain reduced variability (platform-like) until index 520, after which gradual drift begins. Return not observed within allowed context (ends at 579), and no opposing reversal is evident before 579.
